note: Corps of Engineers campground on Nolin River Lake near Leitchfield, spread over two wooded points. The A loop's south shore and the D loop's tips are open ground a few steps above the summer-pool shoreline. Unstaffed apart from volunteer hosts. Boat ramp, fishing pier and a marina; the Shady Creek Trail starts in the area. --Claude
summary: Kept. Fees 18 (non-electric) / 32 (electric), stored 32-32. 164 catalog sites (description says 167), 50A + water, lengths to 100 ft, 15 pull-throughs; flush toilets, showers, dump. Season 2027 May 7 - Oct 16 (2026 May 1 - Oct 17). Reservations required (fcfs never), 14-night max. Lakefront CONFIRMED on named A and D loop sites by 3DEP to the 515-ft summer pool.
flags: WATERFRONT CONFIRMED lakefront (USACE: measured with 3DEP to the 157.0 m / 515 ft summer-pool contour, which matches the vegetation line on the drawdown imagery). Over open grass with scattered trees: D032 37.313757,-86.233189 (pad 158.9 m, 1.9 m up, pool at 11 m), D031 37.313792,-86.233367 (2.3 m up at 14 m), D012 37.313785,-86.234794 (2.8 m at 16 m), D030 37.314164,-86.233568 (3.0 m at 14 m), and the A loop's south-shore row A033 37.314156,-86.239703 (3.0 m at 9 m), A034 37.314196,-86.239544 (2.8 m at 8 m), A035 37.314257,-86.239370 (2.8 m at 9 m), A036 37.314319,-86.239160 (2.7 m at 7 m) - slopes about 17-38%. All are reservable by the night and permit RV/Trailer (A033-A036 non-electric 45-50 ft; D030/D032 50 ft with water; D031 30 ft; D012 85 ft). Higher rows (A013-A030, D004-D011, the C loop 8-11 m up) are views. rec.gov carries no 'Proximity to Water' tags here. Suggested evidence: 'rec.gov per-site coords + 3DEP 2026-11-24: D031/D032 1.9-2.3 m above the 157.0 m (515 ft) summer pool at 11-14 m; D012/D030 2.8-3.0 m at 14-16 m; A033-A036 2.7-3.0 m at 7-9 m over open grass'. The stored evidence (pin 37.3138,-86.2348 'pads at the water's edge') was a drawdown look only.
